statements.t: “TARA-002 has the potential to be a preferred treatment option for patients with non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC), and we are on track to complete enrollment of the BCG-Unresponsive registrational cohort by year-end, a key step toward bringing this therapy to patients.
Shefferman added, “Turning to our rare disease pipeline, we now expect to complete enrollment of the registrational STARBORN-1 trial of TARA-002 in LMs early in the first quarter of 2027.
Supported by the program’s Breakthrough Therapy designation, we remain on track to initiate our rolling Biologics License Application (BLA) submission in the second half of 2027.
We also completed enrollment of the Phase 2b portion of the THRIVE-3 trial of IV Choline Chloride and look forward to reporting interim results by the end of this year.”
